subject: Opus Production: throughput & 5xx spike — credit structuring & contract amendment
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@opusanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@opusanalytics.com
Date: 2027-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production impact — sustained 5xx and throughput drop (urgent)

Jasmine / Ben,

We saw a sustained regression across our batch inference pipelines starting 2027-09-18 23:40 UTC: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.1% to 6.4% and average per-request latency doubled for sequences >1k tokens. Throughput also dropped ~35% during peak windows. Our SREs attached a short CSV with aggregated error/latency buckets — see opus-incident-log-20270919.csv.

This is causing timeouts for several customer-facing endpoints; we've had to throttle some jobs to avoid cascading failures. We're requesting: (1) an immediate ops call to identify root cause, (2) a provisional credit for the impacted windows in accordance with our SLA while we triage, and (3) a timeline for remediation and contract amendment if this is systemic.

Can you confirm availability for a 30m sync in the next 2 hours?

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Engineering, Opus Analytics
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@opusanalytics.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@opusanalytics.com
Date: 2027-09-19T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact — sustained 5xx and throughput drop (urgent)

Alex — thanks for flagging and for the incident log. I'm sorry you're seeing this.

We're pulling the serving and routing team now. I can join a call at 11:00 PT / 18:00 UTC and we'll bring our runtime leads. Immediate asks from our side to help triage faster:
- Can you paste a short snippet of a failing request (without customer PII) or a representative request-id?
- Any recent config changes on your side (batch sizing, sequence length spikes, payload changes) in last 48h?

Prelim: we'll provision an emergency canary route (short-lived) to isolate model variant and will propose a provisional credit calculation after the first triage pass. Ben — can you own the commercial touch with Opus during the triage?

-Jasmine
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@opusanalytics.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-19T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact — sustained 5xx and throughput drop (urgent)

Alex — I'm on it. We'll be on the 11:00 PT call. For the provisional credit: my suggested approach is to (A) establish the impacted window(s) from your logs, (B) quantify affected token/embedding units, and (C) map to the SLA credit tiers. If the hit is >24 hours or recurring, we should talk contract amendment (caps / remediation SLAs).

Attached is a template credit matrix I prepared last quarter that we can adapt: proposed-credit-matrix-Opus-v1.xlsx. Laura / Rishi — please standby for potential exec review if Opus requests >$X threshold.

-Ben
Principal, Account Exec
Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@opusanalytics.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, eng@opusanalytics.com
Date: 2027-09-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: ops call notes + draft commercial path (was: Production impact — sustained 5xx and throughput drop)

Alex — thanks again for the call on 9/19 and for the additional logs. Summary of what we saw and next steps: 
- Root cause (runtime): a kernel-selection fallback on a subset of quantized model shards caused inefficient memory paths under the sequence length distribution you pushed during the window. This produced increased latency and elevated 5xx for long sequences.
- Triage steps taken: emergency canary to a compatible model variant (reduced latency, eliminated 5xx in preliminary tests), hotfix to routing to avoid the problematic shard, and short-term autoscale bump during peak windows.

Commercial path I propose (attached draft amendment):
1) Provisional credit covering 2027-09-18 23:40 UTC -> 2027-09-19 06:30 UTC equal to 120% of the calculated usage during impacted tokens (to reflect customer-impact uplift).
2) If we see a recurrence within 90 days, increase remedial credit to 200% for repeat window and commit to a prioritized workload-specific performance pass (engineering SLA).
3) Add a short contract amendment that clarifies remediation/priority routing for Opus workloads and a quarterly performance review for the next year.

Laura / Rishi — this is the point where we need legal and finance to sign off (whether the provisional multiplier and recurrence escalation are acceptable). I'm attaching a draft amendment named amendment-draft-Opus-20270922.docx for your review.

Alex — can you confirm the impacted token counts (or grant Ben access to the usage slice) so we can lock the numbers? If you're comfortable with the approach above, Ben will circulate a formal amendment and timeline.

Best,
Jasmine
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@opusanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, eng@opusanalytics.com
Date: 2027-09-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: ops call notes + draft commercial path (was: Production impact — sustained 5xx and throughput drop)

Thanks Jasmine — the summary matches our SRE view. We've extracted token counts for the impacted window and will share the trimmed slice with Ben by EOD (we blurred customer identifiers). We appreciate the 120% provisional multiplier — that sounds reasonable as a starting point.

Two asks before we finalize:
- Please add a short clause that gives Opus the right to an emergency rollback to the compatible model variant (no config changes) during any future detection window while a fix is in flight.
- We'd like the amendment to include a 30-day SLA performance review checkpoint after the first remediation pass.

Assuming those two are in, we can move quickly — Ben, please send the formal amendment and I can route for signature.

Alex
